title: Chlorine's isotopes and its relative atomic mass
caption: A mass spectrum of chlorine atoms shows ³⁵Cl (75.8%) and ³⁷Cl (24.2%). The weighted mean, (34.97 × 75.8 + 36.97 × 24.2) ÷ 100, is 35.45, the relative atomic mass in the periodic table.
alt: Mass spectrum with two lines: m/z 35 at 75.8% and m/z 37 at 24.2%.
description: A tall line at m/z 35, abundance 75.8%.
A shorter line at m/z 37, abundance 24.2%.
